correctness.rationale: The GQ axiom yields A³=(s+t)A+H exactly, with AH=diag((t+1)J_P,(s+1)J_L) in F2. A⁴=0 with A³ nonzero for odd-odd parameters; otherwise E=A⁴ is an idempotent nonzero spectral projector, A²E=E, and A³(I+E)=0 with A²(I+E) nonzero. The nonzero zero-primary Jordan block of size 4 or 3 leads to temporal order 8; nonzero one-primary yields the factor 3 otherwise. Rank-inferred Jordan counts, separable quadratic temporal blocks and Möbius inversion prove every fixed-point/orbit formula. Two separate self-contained Python verifiers replayed over symplectic (2,2),(3,3),(5,5), duad–syntheme (2,2), thin (2,1),(3,1) examples; each checked exact matrix orders and fixed-space dimensions. Universal validity rests on the algebraic proof, not finite sampling.

value.rationale: An order-wide classification of a natural finite-incidence family gives the sharp 8-versus-24 time-clock transition, including thin and nonclassical cases and mixed-parity realization, together with the complete primitive-period polynomial in computable binary ranks. The GQ cubic incidence identity explains why the order is insensitive to geometry while fixed populations are not; this is structurally different from re-enumerating small graph states or substituting a different finite field into an existing formula.
